name: France

flag.description: Three equal vertical stripes of blue, white and red from the hoist.
flag.symbolism: Blue and red are the traditional colours of Paris, and white was the colour of the monarchy; together they came to represent the Revolution and the Republic.

hook: France stands blue-white-red upright from the flagpole; the Netherlands lays red-white-blue flat, and Italy swaps the blue for green.
trivia: The French Navy's ensign uses stripes of unequal width (30:33:37) so they look equal when the flag flaps.
In 2020 the Élysée Palace switched back to a darker navy blue for the flags it flies.
